sections.Profile:
Lucky Fruit, produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1975, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine with a fruit-themed motif. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, a four-bank drop target, and four rotating targets.

- Manufacturer: Zaccaria
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Women, Good Times, Farming, Nature, Original Theme, Trees, 1970s, Single level playfield, Fruit
